source.title: List of charities: Codes Lists (English), version 1.0

transcription: Text layer of the CRA PDF, read with macOS PDFKit. Category labels come from section 2.1 “Categories” (English column); the text layer prints the English codes and labels as one run, which was split at each four-digit code, and two labels that wrap onto a second line (0013, 0080) were joined with a space. Each category is assigned to the section 2.2.1 to 2.2.4 heading under which the PDF lists its sub-categories. Designation codes come from section 2.4. Wording and capitalization are kept as printed, including “NASO” for 0215. Sub-category labels are not transcribed; dossiers show the sub-category code as published.
